mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM wm_stock_document d WHERE d.source_workorder_id=#{workorderId} AND d.document_type='MATERIAL_ISSUE' AND d.production_request_id IS NOT NULL AND (d.production_confirmation_status IS NOT NULL OR d.production_confirmed_at IS NOT NULL))

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(d.production_output_qty),0) AS output_qty, COALESCE(SUM(component_totals.material_qty),0) AS material_qty, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.production_output_qty>0 AND component_totals.line_count=1 AND component_totals.material_id=#{materialId} AND component_totals.unit_id=#{unitId} AND component_totals.material_qty>0 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END),0) AS invalid_count FROM wm_stock_document d LEFT JOIN (SELECT l.document_id,COUNT(*) AS line_count,MIN(l.material_id) AS material_id, MIN(l.unit_id) AS unit_id,SUM(l.quantity) AS material_qty FROM wm_stock_document_line l JOIN wm_stock_document issue_header ON issue_header.id=l.document_id WHERE issue_header.source_workorder_id=#{workorderId} GROUP BY l.document_id) component_totals ON component_totals.document_id=d.id WHERE d.source_workorder_id=#{workorderId} AND d.document_type='MATERIAL_ISSUE' AND d.status!='CANCELLED' AND d.production_request_id IS NOT NULL AND (d.production_confirmation_status IS NOT NULL OR d.production_confirmed_at IS NOT NULL) AND d.production_input_kind='PRODUCTION_INPUT' AND COALESCE(d.production_void_result_status,'') != #{voided} AND (d.production_confirmation_status IS NULL OR d.production_confirmation_status != #{rejected})
